'''Ōtomo no Sukunamaro''' (大伴 宿奈麻呂) was a {{ill|Nobility|en|Nobility|qid=Q134737|lt=noble}} and {{ill|waka poet|ja|歌人}} of the early {{ill|Nara period|en|Nara period|qid=Q189178|lt=Nara period}}. He was the third son of {{ill|Otomo no Otomaro|ja|大伴安麻呂}}. His court Rank was {{ill|Jushi-i|ja|従四位下|lt=Junior Fourth Rank, Lower Grade}}, and he served as {{ill|benkan|ja|弁官|lt=Benkan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q3270768}} (Right Major Controller).

== Career ==
In the {{ill|Wadō (era)|en|Wadō (era)|qid=Q1373026|lt=Wadō}} era under {{ill|Empress Genmei|en|Empress Genmei|qid=Q233224|lt=Empress Genmei}}, Sukunamaro was promoted three Ranks from {{ill|Jurokui|ja|従六位上|lt=Junior Sixth Rank, Upper Grade}} to {{ill|Jugo-i|ja|従五位下|lt=Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade}} in 708 CE. Over the next years, his career progressed steadily:
- Promoted to {{ill|Jugo-i no Jō|ja|従五位上|lt=Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade}} in 712 CE.
- Advanced to {{ill|Shogo-i|ja|正五位下|lt=Senior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade}} in 717 CE and to {{ill|Shogo-i no Jō|ja|正五位上|lt=Senior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade}} in 720 CE under {{ill|Empress Genshō|en|Empress Genshō|qid=Q235343|lt=Empress Genshō}}.

While serving as Governor of {{ill|Bizen Province|bn|বাইজেন প্রদেশ|cs|Provincie Bizen|de|Provinz Bizen|es|Provincia de Bizen|fa|ولایت بیزن|fr|Province de Bizen|gl|Provincia de Bizen|id|Provinsi Bizen|it|Bizen (provincia)|ja|備前国|ko|비젠국|lt|Bidzeno žemė|nl|Bizen (provincie)|pt|Província de Bizen|ru|Бидзэн (провинция)|simple|Bizen Province|sk|Bizen (provincia)|sr|Провинција Бизен|tr|Bizen (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Бідзен|zh|備前國|zh_min_nan|Bizen-kok|qid=Q1053688|lt=Bizen Province}} in 719 CE, he was concurrently appointed Inspector of {{ill|Aki Province|en|Aki Province|qid=Q965029|lt=Aki Province}} and {{ill|Suō Province|en|Suō Province|qid=Q1053037|lt=Suo Province}}. 

In the first year of {{ill|Jinki (era)|en|Jinki (era)|qid=Q1373210|lt=Shinki}} (724 CE), shortly after {{ill|Emperor Shōmu|en|Emperor Shōmu|qid=Q349263|lt=Emperor Shōmu}} ascended the throne, he was promoted to {{ill|Jushi-i|ja|従四位下|lt=Junior Fourth Rank, Lower Grade}}. He is believed to have passed away around 727 CE.

Sukunamaro's poetry includes love songs addressed to a court lady, with two of his poems preserved in the {{ill|Man'yōshū|en|Man'yōshū|qid=Q834321|lt=Man'yōshū}}.<ref>{{Cite Man'yōshū|volume=4|poems=532, 533}}</ref> According to a later entry in the same collection, he resided in Tamura-ri (modern-day {{ill|Nara (city)|en|Nara (city)|qid=Q169134|lt=Nara City}}, Nitatsujichō) and held the post of Right Major Controller.<ref>{{Cite Man'yōshū|volume=4|poem=759}}</ref>
